title: Jesus Loves You
textBlocks:
Hello Braverhearts
Today we are going to learn that 
Jesus loves us & looks after us.
He wants to bless us.

To tell Aaron and his sons,
HOW TO BLESS THE ISRAELITES
Ask you mom or dad to read this blessing over you every day at bed time

Blessings are wonderful
They are from God

God blessed Abraham with many children

God blessed the Israelites with peace, food and with Himself

He blesses us with family, friends and rain…

YOU CAN ALSO BE A BLESSING 
to your MOM, DAD, brothers, sisters, friends, cousins, grannies and granpa
by being KIND and GENTLE
by what you do and say
